scope: Checked-in source and bundled hooks only. Lexical candidates include tests, declarations and false positives; dynamic/native/extension indexes require human classification. Private institution hooks and stored queries remain an adoption blocker owned by each institution.

owners.resource: mongodb and redboxStorage adapter managers / generated junction and archive
owners.ownership: Sails ORM owns adapter pools; all model/service users borrow; app.lower owns teardown.
owners.replacement: P1 app-owned runtime and P11 connected-definition removal; archive history needs institution assessment.

owners.resource: application native driver + Prisma client; loaded CacheEntry config/preflight manager
owners.ownership: Cache runtime owns driver; Prisma borrows it; close both in finally/Promise.all. Mapping/preflight still borrow Waterline.
owners.replacement: Preserve pilot lifecycle; P11 removes model dependency only after stable gate.

owners.ownership: AppConfigSecrets borrows mongodb manager. String _id, BSON Date expiry, owner/freshness predicates, 20s heartbeat / 120s lease; never closes borrowed manager.
owners.replacement: Private lease repository; AWS effects outside database unit.

owners.ownership: DashboardConfigService borrows model manager, creates unique branding index; single-document aggregate copy; no client ownership.
owners.replacement: Scoped operator DDL readiness plus explicit compare-and-set.

owners.resource: harvestrun conditional counters and ID factory
owners.ownership: HarvestRunService borrows manager/client and discovers pkFactory for ObjectId; no close.
owners.replacement: Private ID codec and atomic counter operations; preserve dedup/index intent.

owners.resource: configured event/attempt collections, indexes, owner-token leases and retention
owners.ownership: SiemDeliveryStore borrows resolved model datastores/managers, creates indexes; never closes them.
owners.replacement: Delivery store owns private Mongo operations, explicit readiness and drain before shared close.

owners.resource: figsharesync CAS replacements, claims, generations, receipts and partial/unique indexes
owners.ownership: Sync store borrows model manager; worker borrows store/storage; no driver owned.
owners.replacement: Explicit sync store operations and durable source-intent acknowledgment; keep Mongo fencing.

owners.resource: six storage collections + recordidentity + native cursors/aggregate/schema retention/backfill
owners.ownership: MongoStorageService borrows redboxStorage Db via models; caches collection/cursor handles, not a new client. Backfill borrows same Db; closes no pool.
owners.replacement: Private storage adapter retains native CAS/staged protocols, cursor finally/iteration and bounded 500 backfill; separate atomic U participation is G-TX.

owners.resource: configured Agenda collection + History and optional address-backed pool / SQS
owners.ownership: AgendaQueueService always obtains User manager, including SQS setup; history/index uses it. MongoBackend borrows supplied Db or owns address connection. No application stop/drain/close wiring found.
owners.replacement: P1 removes User dependence; P10 stop claims, drain workers, close owned backend, then shared persistence. SQS owns AWS client/stop path, no Mongo pool.

owners.resource: connect-mongo sessions store/client and TTL index
owners.ownership: redboxSession constructs MongoStore.create from session config (default sessions database); express middleware retains store, no app lifecycle handle/close wiring.
owners.replacement: Retain TTL/cookie/auth behavior; register store.close with app shutdown, await before persistence teardown.

owners.resource: GridFS configured database/bucket .files/.chunks and independent cached clients
owners.ownership: GridFSDriver static process-wide dbCache owns MongoClient per resolved cache key; dispose closes cached clients but no production caller. StorageManagerService composes Flydrive FS/S3/GridFS without disposal.
owners.replacement: App-scoped ownership or explicit reference counts, drain streams, handle partial init/close, isolate apps; blob interface stays separate.

owners.resource: legacy logo GridFS reader in effective application database
owners.ownership: BrandingLogoService owns a short-lived MongoClient and closes in finally; not the shared Flydrive cache.
owners.replacement: Keep legacy reads/DB resolution and independent finally cleanup.

owners.resource: optional Waterline transaction connection, no new MongoClient
owners.ownership: Four importing services borrow datastore and pass usingConnection when supplied. Unsupported adapter executes once without connection; no rollback guarantee.
owners.replacement: Plain atomic domain operations and supported runtime/session proof after G-TX, never native-session bypass.

owners.resource: historical migrations, standalone index scripts, generated maintenance templates
owners.ownership: MigrationRunner borrows Migration model; scripts borrow shell db or loaded models, no application-owned pool. Standalone spike scripts own and close their own clients.
owners.replacement: Named, scoped maintenance operations, same ledger names; no replay of already recorded bodies.
